files.config/report_delivery.yml:
default: &default
  attempts: 5
  delay_seconds: 30
  retry_on_timeout: true

production:
  <<: *default

test:
  <<: *default
files.spec/requests/report_delivery_spec.rb:
RSpec.describe 'Report delivery requests' do
  it 'uses test retry settings' do
    settings = ReportDelivery.settings_for(:test)
    expect(settings.attempts).to eq(2)
    expect(settings.delay_seconds).to eq(0)
    expect(settings.retry_on_timeout).to eq(false)
  end
end
files.spec/jobs/report_delivery_job_spec.rb:
RSpec.describe ReportDeliveryJob do
  it 'retries a production timeout' do
    settings = ReportDelivery.settings_for(:production)
    expect(settings.attempts).to eq(5)
    expect(settings.delay_seconds).to eq(30)
    expect(settings.retry_on_timeout).to eq(true)
  end

  it 'uses the test delay' do
    expect(ReportDelivery.settings_for(:test).delay_seconds).to eq(10)
  end
end
